prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
competitors_mentioned: Palm Beach Tan at The Arboretum
answer_verbatim:
For a **spray tan**, **Organic Bronze Bar in SouthPark** looks like a strong pick: it specializes in organic airbrush tanning and reports a **5.0 Trustindex score**. It’s at **2907 Providence Rd., Suite 102A**. [Website](https://organicbronzebar.com/southpark/)

If you want **UV tanning beds** as well as spray tanning, consider **Palm Beach Tan at The Arboretum**; its listed rating is **4.54/5**. Ratings and hours can change, so check before you go. [Location details](https://palmbeachtan.com/locations/nc/charlotte-john-j-delaney-drive)

“Best” depends on whether you’re after a spray tan or a tanning bed—and note that UV tanning carries skin-cancer and premature-aging risks.
